name: CaseHardOutlineRingRestPlane
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "hard-outline-ring-rest-plane" (non-stroke-ink). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: outline: 2px solid + outline-offset on the REST plane (not a focus state)
